oe_ttb_byz_army = {
    value = 0

}
# Any scope. 2 times Byzantium's army size (AI threshold).
oe_ttb_byz_army_ai = { value = oe_ttb_byz_army multiply = 2 }
# BYZ scope. The yearly tribute for peace: 3 months of total income, rounded, at least 1 gold.
oe_ttb_peace_amount = {
    value = monthly_income_total
    multiply = 3
    add = 0.5
    floor = yes
    min = 1
}
# BYZ scope, scope:oe_ttb_t = the target. Chance in percent that a target at peace accepts.
oe_ttb_accept_chance = {
    value = 70
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_ttb_t scope:oe_ttb_t = { opinion = { target = c:BYZ value < -50 } } }
        add = -30
    }
}
# BYZ scope. AI insurance: the yearly dues of every running agreement (0 when there is none).
oe_ttb_ai_dues = {
    value = 0
    every_country = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_ttb_peace }
        add = var:oe_ttb_peace
    }
}
# BYZ scope. AI insurance readouts (0 while unset): months in the red, months recovered, held (1/0), payments held.
oe_ttb_ai_rd_red = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ttb_ai_red } value = var:oe_ttb_ai_red } }
oe_ttb_ai_rd_ok = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ttb_ai_ok } value = var:oe_ttb_ai_ok } }
oe_ttb_ai_rd_hold = { value = 0 if = { limit = { var:oe_ttb_ai_hold ?= 1 } value = 1 } }
oe_ttb_ai_rd_held = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ttb_ai_held_n } value = var:oe_ttb_ai_held_n } }
